**Our purpose

**Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with offices in the UK, Norway and Germany, and supports over 400,000 users across Europe and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You'll Make An Impact

**The Monetization team owns how customers buy and keep buying Planday: the checkout experience, subscription management, payments, and the systems behind them (our subscription and billing services, plus the integration layer to Zuora, Salesforce and Intercom). When a customer upgrades a plan, adds a product, or gets an invoice, that is our code path.

As a Full Stack Engineer at IC2, you will build and maintain features across that path, front end and back end, with support from engineers on the team. You will start with well-scoped pieces of customer-facing work and grow into owning features end to end.

You will join a cross-functional team of full stack engineers, a QA engineer, a UX researcher and a product manager. You will be paired with an engineer as your mentor from day one, and you will be expected to ask questions early and often: in a domain where mistakes are visible on customer invoices.

You will use AI coding tools every day, as the whole team does. We care less about how fast you can produce code and more about whether you can tell good output from plausible-looking output, and whether you can explain and defend what you ship.

**What You'll Do

**

• Create software: Build features across the stack: C# / .NET services and React + TypeScript front ends (We have one service in Java). Contribute to solution design discussions and take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.

• Work with AI tools, with judgement: Use AI coding assistants as part of normal delivery. Read, test and question what they produce. Never merge code you cannot explain line by line.

• Test software: Write and automate tests alongside your changes. Treat quality as part of the work rather than a later stage, with support from the team's QA engineer.

• Resolve issues: Help triage and fix development and production issues in the subscription, checkout and payments flows. Learn to trace a problem across services and third-party platforms, and communicate impact in business terms.

• Engineering standards : Learn and apply Planday's Engineering Standards. Take part in the Backend and Frontend Guilds to build a shared standard with engineers outside the team.

• Understand the domain : Build working knowledge of how plans, entitlements, invoices and payments fit together. In monetization, the business rules are the hard part; the code is often the easy part.

• Continuous improvement : Keep growing your knowledge of the technologies we use, and bring back what you learn to the team.

• Deliver in production : Ship your own changes through our CI/CD pipelines and watch how they behave once live.

**Success looks like

**

• First three months: you ship small customer-facing changes to production with review support, you can explain the plan-change and invoicing paths in your own words, and you ask for help before you are stuck for a day.

• First twelve months: you own well-scoped features end to end across front end and back end, you catch your own errors before review does, you are a dependable second pair of eyes in code review, and you can explain the customer and revenue impact of what you build.

• Quality and pace: You deliver at a predictable, sustainable pace and flag risks and blockers early rather than at the deadline.

• Learning: You actively learn from your peers, act on feedback, and turn each review comment into something you no longer need told twice.

• Judgment with AI: You use AI tools to move faster without lowering the bar: you verify output, you confidently spot wrong suggestions, and you own everything you merge.

• Communication: You keep your team informed, write clearly in tickets and pull requests, and give Product accurate information so scope and timing decisions can be made.

**What You'll Bring With You

****Critical competencies

**

• Growth mindset: You treat skill as something built, not fixed, and you go looking for feedback.

• Verification habit: You check things: you read the error, you run the test, you look at the data before you conclude.

• Problem-solving: You can break a problem down and describe your reasoning out loud, including the parts you are unsure about.

• Team player: You contribute to a collaborative team and are comfortable working closely with QA, UX and Product.

• Communication and time management: You are clear about progress, blockers and what you need.

• Care for the customer: You understand that billing and checkout bugs cost customers money and trust.

**Experience We Would Like To See

**We expect a junior engineer here to have roughly 1 to 2 years of professional experience, or equivalent evidence of building and shipping real software (internships, open-source, freelance).

• Working knowledge of one backend language, ideally C# / .NET

• Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, and a component framework such as React

• Comfortable with SQL and relational data

• Comfortable with Git, pull requests and code review

• Familiar with consuming and building REST APIs

• Some exposure to automated testing

• Hands-on use of AI coding tools (for example Claude, Codex, Copilot or Cursor) and an opinion about where they help and where they do not

• Nice to have: exposure to CI/CD, cloud platforms (we run on Azure), Redis, message-based integration between systems, or billing and subscription domains

You do not need to tick every line. If you can show us that you build things, verify your own work, and learn fast, we want to talk to you.

**How We Use AI In This Hiring Process

**We use AI tools in our daily work, so we do not pretend otherwise when hiring.

• The technical interview: it runs in two halves. First you read and review code with your AI tools closed, so we can see how you read. Then you open your usual tools and build, as you would on the job. We will tell you exactly when the switch happens.

• What we assess: your reasoning, your ability to explain and defend code (including code that a tool wrote), and your judgement about when to trust output. Using AI is not a problem; being unable to explain your work is.

**At Planday, we offer you

**

• Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

• On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

• Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

• Flexible remote work

• Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

• Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

• Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

_At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

**AI Academy Intake - Copenhagen (on-site, full-time)

**At Light, we're redefining how software is built, how it's delivered, and how it works.

We're building organic software. Software that heals itself. Software that adapts to the user and the business. Software that learns and gets better as it's used.

Our starting point is finance. Companies including Legora, Lovable, and Fuse Energy run on Light. We're building towards a platform that understands how each business operates and evolves with it.

The AI Academy

The AI Academy is where Light builds its future leaders for an ever-changing world. It's a small cohort of exceptional early-career people who take an operating process in marketing, sales, finance, partnerships, customer success, product or any other team, and rebuild it so AI agents do the work and humans handle the exceptions. Then they move on to the next one.

We believe roles will increasingly merge, and that cross-functional collaboration and broad knowledge of the business will define high-performing teams. The Academy is built around that:

• Training. You start with a period of training on how to use AI to drive business outcomes: tools, agents, automations, and how to judge their output.

• Several functions at once. You then apply it across several functions, splitting your time between teams such as marketing, sales, finance, partnerships, customer success and product.

• Focus. Over time you move into fewer functions, where you've had the most impact and want to go deepest.

In this role you're a member of Light's AI Academy. You'll undergo specialised AI training and be pushed to use AI in every aspect of your job and to re-think the status quo from first principles.

This training will enable you to effectively build operations and companies at scale. If you aspire to be a future single-person unicorn founder, this is the ideal training ground.

**Who This Is For

**You must meet this requirement: an exceptional level of achievement in a highly competitive endeavour. Work experience in itself is irrelevant, past hires have been 17 years and older. For example:

• A gold medal at the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) or International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI)

• Experience at McKinsey QuantumBlack, the Goldman Sachs Special Situations Group or TMT group (regular IBD do not apply), Optiver, Jane Street or similar.

• Having built or sold a company

• Competed in elite-level sport (e.g. a sub-8-hour Ironman, the Olympic Games, or a European or World Championship, football or basketball at highest level)

• A FIDE chess rating of 2,400 or higher (IM level)

• An equivalent level of achievement in another highly competitive endeavour

• Top of class in high-school year

If you're applying with an equivalent achievement, explain the competition or field, your result, and the standard required to achieve it. If you don't have an equivalent level of achievement we encourage you to not apply.

Our bar at Light is high, and this is more than just a job. You will need the curiosity to explore unfamiliar areas, the willingness to go the extra mile to get things right, the discipline to test your assumptions, and the persistence to keep going when your first approach does not work.

We hold two bars: outperforming your metrics, and being kind and supportive of each other. Exceptional ability without kindness is not a fit.

What you'll work on

You'll be in charge of building agentic factories that re-think what is possible across product, marketing, implementation, customer service.

• Rethink work from first principles. Take a process in marketing, sales, finance, partnerships, customer success, or product. Ask what outcome it exists to deliver, and redesign it around what AI now makes possible. Making the old process faster is the easy part.

• Own operations end to end. Take full ownership of processes across finance operations, people operations, and legal and compliance, working directly with the Chief of Staff to CEO. Run them, then rebuild them so agents do the work and nothing falls through the cracks.

• Build the agents and workflows yourself. Identify where manual work can be automated or standardised, and build the solution rather than waiting for someone else to do so.

• Move fast. Ship a first version in hours and iterate several times a day.

• Participate in the AI Academy. Complete the specialised AI training, apply what you learn in every function you work in, and share what worked and what didn't so the rest of the cohort and the teams can adopt it.

• Own projects through delivery. Scope the problem, build the solution, debug regressions, and follow through until the team can rely on what you've shipped.

You'll work alongside exceptional colleagues.

What else we're looking for

• Clear thinking and the ability to explain your decisions, including what you tried and why it didn't work.

• Kindness. You make the people around you better.

How we'll measure success

Your work should produce measurable improvements: 10 to 1,000x output capacity.

What you'll get

• Full-time compensation above the standard market rate.

• Every tool available. We give everyone in the Academy access to all the AI tools on the market, and put you in the environment that will make you a success.

• A role based in our Copenhagen office, working alongside the teams and the AI Academy cohort.

• Ownership from your first day, with a path to owning a function.

How to apply

Send your CV.

Include a link to, or a description of, something you've built. Tell us what it does, which parts you built yourself, where it failed, and how you fixed it. Then explain why you want to join the AI Academy at Light.

We want to understand how you think, what you can build, and what you're ready to take on next.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A STRATEGIC AND CULTURE-DRIVEN HEAD OF PR TO JOIN OUR PR & COMMS TEAM IN COPENHAGEN. THIS ROLE DEFINES AND LEADS OUR GLOBAL PUBLIC RELATIONS STRATEGY AND EXECUTION

**Your Mission & Responsibilities Ahead Of You

**You will be responsible for defining and executing GANNI’s global PR strategy across all markets, ensuring a strong and consistent brand presence while allowing for local relevance. This includes leading seasonal storytelling, key brand moments and global campaigns that shape how GANNI shows up in culture.

A key part of the role is overseeing all global media and press relations, building and maintaining strong relationships with international editors, journalists and opinion leaders, while managing press calendars, media lists, press releases and global announcements. You will also lead the PR strategy for key events including Fashion Week, brand activations, collaborations and special projects, working closely with internal teams and external partners to bring brand moments to life.

In addition, you will manage and coordinate local PR agencies across key markets (UK, US, CHINA), ensuring clear alignment, strong execution and consistent performance through defined KPIs and reporting frameworks.

The role further includes defining and leading the global talent and cultural partnerships strategy, building and maintaining strong relationships with international key opinion leaders and cultural voices aligned with the brand. You will own and manage the global PR budget, while continuously tracking and analysing PR performance, media impact and brand visibility, translating insights into actionable improvements.

**Must Have Requirements

**We are looking for a candidate with strong experience within PR and communications, who is comfortable operating in a fast-paced, international and creative environment. You are both strategic and hands-on, with a strong ability to turn vision into execution.

• Solid experience in PR and communications, ideally within fashion, luxury or lifestyle brands

• Proven experience leading global PR strategies and working across international markets

• Strong network within global fashion, lifestyle and cultural media

• Experience managing agencies and cross-regional teams

• Strategic thinker with a hands-on, execution-driven mindset

• Strong storytelling, communication and relationship-building skills

• English fluent (mandatory), Danish or other languages a plus

**THE GANNI WAY

We are looking for a true GANNI ambassador - someone who shares our values of Openness (ready to evolve, honest not perfect), Optimism** (you never stand still, just dance!), Authenticity (you march at your own beat!), Accountability (no excuses, you make an impact) & Responsibility (make small changes, see big differences).

The GANNI culture is based on a learning and results-driven mentality, where everyone is united by a common purpose of (hack)the fashion system!

GANNI is a state of mind - more than a way of dressing and we love to change the usual practice in everything we do. We are confident and capable of anything! So prepare yourself to be comfortable with the uncomfortable and hacking the system together with our amazing PR & Comms team!

**DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

**At GANNI, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, racial identity, religious belief, disability status, or personal expression.

We believe that diversity drives creativity and innovation, and we are dedicated to building a team that reflects the world around us.

To support unbiased hiring, we kindly ask you not to include your photo, age, or marital status in your CV - we’re only interested in why you’re a great fit for the role.

**BE BOLD AND JOIN OUR GANNI COMMUNITY!

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel motivated to join our team and become a part of the GANNI community.

We will be interviewing candidates continuously and kindly ask you to send your application and CV as soon as possible. Please use the “Apply for position” button.

**MORE GANNI GOODIES

**You will be working out of our unique GANNI house located in the beautiful City Center of Copenhagen on top of the Bremerholm flagship store. Besides our amazing and colorful new office facilities, we are also proud of our inhouse GANNI kitchen that offers healthy and sustainable food cooked by our passionate in-house chef.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our new Senior Heat Plate Design Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Danfoss' gasketed plate heat exchanger (GPHE) portfolio.

As a senior member of the GPHE New Product Development team, you will drive the development of complete product solutions from concept through production release, helping deliver products that combine strong performance, reliability, quality, and cost competitiveness.

Beyond delivering innovative products, you will contribute your expertise to strengthening the team's technical capabilities. You will act as a mentor and sparring partner for colleagues across development projects, sharing knowledge, supporting complex technical problem solving, and helping the team build on proven engineering practices and lessons learned.

This role is ideal for an experienced product development engineer who enjoys combining hands-on engineering with technical depth and who is motivated by creating solutions that improve energy efficiency and support sustainable applications worldwide.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**As part of our GPHE New Product Development team, you will lead the development of complete GPHE products from concept through launch and industrialization.

**Key Responsibilities Include

**

• Lead the development of GPHE products from concept creation through validation, industrialization, and successful production release

• Translate customer, market, and business needs into robust product requirements and technical solutions

• Develop and optimize GPHE product architectures to achieve performance, reliability, manufacturability, compliance, and cost targets

• Drive design activities including simulation, prototyping, testing, validation, DFMEA, technical risk management, and problem-solving throughout the product lifecycle

• Provide technical guidance and mentoring to colleagues while collaborating across global cross-functional teams to ensure successful project execution and knowledge sharing.

In your day-to-day work, you will partner closely with specialists in thermal, hydraulic, and mechanical engineering while contributing to technical reviews, design validation activities, and continuous product improvement initiatives.

**What We're Looking For

**To be successful in this role, you will bring a strong combination of engineering expertise, product development experience, and a collaborative mindset.

**Essential Qualifications

**

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, Product Development, or a related engineering discipline

• Significant experience developing mechanical products from concept through production release and industrialization, preferably within heat exchangers, pressure equipment, industrial products, or similar engineered solutions

• Strong experience with mechanical product design and 3D CAD development, including sheet metal or formed component design

• Proven ability to independently drive complex technical development activities and influence engineering decisions across cross-functional projects

• Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to mentor colleagues and work effectively in a global engineering environment

**Preferred Qualifications

**Experience with GPHE products, thermal systems, heat transfer technologies, simulation-driven development, DFMEA, design validation, and design-for-manufacturing principles would be considered an advantage.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who enjoys combining deep technical expertise with collaboration and knowledge sharing. You naturally take ownership of complex engineering challenges, help develop those around you, and maintain a holistic view of product development while balancing performance, manufacturability, quality, and cost.

**What You'll Get From Us

**At Danfoss, you'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with advanced heat transfer technologies and develop products that improve energy efficiency across a wide range of industrial applications. You will collaborate with experts in thermal engineering, virtual engineering, laboratory testing, manufacturing, and quality, gaining exposure across the full product development lifecycle while helping shape the next generation of GPHE solutions.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

For information about the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Gerd Veierskov, +45 3057 1882

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

• Demonstrated ability to drive and execute results through rigorous operating mechanisms in a matrixed GE HealthCare environment, often working across partner functions and other business organizations

• Exemplary people management, leadership, and communication skills, as well as sales coaching and team-building experience

• Strong business acumen; financial, organizational, compliance, negotiation, problem-solving, and influencing skills

• Impactful executive presence - high-level presentation and interpersonal skills; able to communicate and present ideas to customers in a way that produces understanding and impact and builds effective strategic relationships

• Ability to energize, develop, and build rapport, collaboration and influence at all levels within an organization

• U.S. or Europe Based

Desired Characteristics

• Ability to influence and collaborate with senior-level management teams

• Direct and/or indirect management experience; managing in a matrix

Ambu is redefining the future of endoscopy with a bold vision to become the global leader in the field. As part of this ambition, we aim to be at the forefront of commercial execution.

As our new Global Marketing Communications Manager, GI & ENT, you will drive the global communication strategy and execution for our GI (Gastroenterology) & ENT (Ear-Nose-Throat) business areas.

Based at our headquarters in Ballerup, Denmark, you will work closely with our Downstream Product Management team, as well as our Brand & Creation team, Digital Marketing Specialists, Medical Affairs, and local sales organizations to develop customer-centric, evidence-driven, and commercially impactful communication activities.

You will develop and optimize communication throughout the customer journey and translate customer insights, business priorities, and market opportunities into communication that drives engagement and business results.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Drive the development and execution of global communication activities for GI & ENT, translating commercial priorities, customer insights, and clinical evidence into impactful campaigns, content, and sales enablement tools.

• Develop sales enablement materials and content that empower local commercial teams and strengthen engagement with healthcare professionals

• Partner closely with Downstream Product Management on global product launches, campaigns, and commercial initiatives, supporting launch communication, campaign development, and sales enablement activities.

• Collaborate with the Digital Marketing team to identify performance insights and continuously optimize communication activities.

• Work closely with the Brand & Creation team to deliver sales and marketing materials that are both on-brand and commercially effective.

**You are a commercially minded marketer who enjoys translating business objectives into effective communication and marketing activities. You are proactive and thrive in a dynamic, cross-functional environment

Most importantly, you are motivated by helping others succeed. You get energy from enabling our frontline sales teams with the tools and communication they need to create value for customers and win in the market.

**Skills

**_Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you have:

_

• 6+ years of experience in commercial marketing, marketing communications, or related roles, preferably gained in an agency environment.

• Proven commercial experience within MedTech, Pharma, or other healthcare-related industries.

• Experience developing communication strategies, campaigns, and sales enablement initiatives that support business growth.

• Strong ability to translate customer, market, and business insights into impactful communication.

• A driven, hands-on approach, a strong sense of ownership, and a genuine passion to help local commercial teams succeed.

• Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities across functions and geographies.

• A proactive mindset with the ability to drive new initiatives and continuously improve how we engage customers and stakeholders.

• A degree in Marketing, Business, or related field.

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is on an ambitious growth journey, expanding globally and pushing the boundaries of innovation in healthcare. Here, your contributions will directly shape our success. You'll work in an international head office with a collaborative, open culture where ideas matter and impact is visible.

We offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits along with exciting job challenges and career opportunities contributing to your job satisfaction.

**Job Description

**

Head of Marketing - Nordics and UK

Posting Start Date: 9/9/26

Gentofte, 83, DNK, 2820

**Head of Marketing – Nordics and UK

**

• Location: Gentofte, Copenhagen, Denmark

• Working hours: Full-time

• Work model: Hybrid

• Travel: Regular travel across our markets, particularly the Nordics and the UK

Are you passionate about turning brand and commercial strategy into activation that drives real impact with consumers? Do you want to be the critical link between Brand Marketing and Commercial teams across the Nordics and the UK? Then you might be the person we are looking for.

As our new Head of Marketing – Nordics and UK, you will be part of the Trade & Activation team and play an important role in translating brand and commercial strategies into impactful market activation plans that drive adult consumer engagement, strengthen brand equity and deliver commercial growth across the Nordic and UK markets. You will work closely with Brand Marketing and Commercial teams to ensure our brands come to life consistently and effectively across channels, customers and consumer touchpoints. Reporting to the Trade & Activation Director for Europe, you will lead and develop a team of 7 direct reports. This is a great opportunity to act as the critical link between brand strategy and commercial execution in an international organization.

**What Your Day Will Look Like

**In this role, you will typically focus on:

• Own the activation agenda for our Nordic and UK markets, translating brand and commercial priorities and channel-specific strategies into impactful market programs.

• Develop and execute annual activation plans that drive adult consumer recruitment, engagement, retention and brand preference across the portfolio.

• Partner closely with Sales and Key Account teams to build customer activation plans that strengthen distribution, visibility, conversion and category growth.

• Translate consumer, shopper and market insights into activation programs that create measurable commercial impact.

• Manage the development and deployment of activation toolkits, point-of-sale materials and execution standards to ensure consistent market execution.

• Monitor activation performance, evaluate ROI and continuously optimize investment allocation, contributing to annual commercial planning.

**What You'll Bring

We are looking for a Financial Controller to lead the operational and analytical work behind our monthly close, group consolidation, project controlling and control environment of a fast-growing energy trading and technology group – and to rebuild them AI-first, so our numbers are faster, more reliable and ready for scale.

Why this role matters

Hybrid Greentech is scaling fast as a VPP, BRP and electricity retailer across Denmark, and Northern Europe. Energy trading means large and volatile daily revenue, cost and cash transactions – so quality , accuracy and liquidity control are not back-office topics; they decide how fast we can grow. This role exists to give management, the board and investors numbers they can trust, on time, and to build controls and automation that scale with the business rather than with headcount. The same discipline is needed in our consultancy arm, where technical consultants deliver advisory and EPC management projects: clear project economics, timely invoicing and early warning when a project drifts.

The role

As Financial Controller, you report to our Finance Manager and work closely with the CFO and our accountant in a small, hands-on finance team. You lead the operational and analytical work within the financial steering, reporting and finance and business analytics; running the month-end close, the consolidation of our group entities in Denmark and abroad, balance sheet reconciliations, project controlling and the day-to-day operation of our internal controls. This is an individual contributor role with high ownership and direct visibility towards management.

You will work in close collaboration with our settlement team, project managers and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting, partner with our accountant on more complex accounting topics, and work across trading, portfolio management, commercial and engineering. We are a tech-first company with high AI adoption, and we expect you to work that way too: AI tools, scripting and automation are your default approach to removing manual work from close, reconciliation and reporting – combined with the judgement to know when a number needs a human review.

What you will do

• Lead and execute the monthly close and group consolidation, including account mapping, intercompany eliminations, reconciliations and variance analysis, and prepare the monthly financial and business review for the CFO, management and the board.

• Set up and run project controlling – project budgets, hours and utilisation, work in progress, milestone and fixed-fee revenue recognition and timely invoicing – giving project managers and business owners clear steering on margin, estimate-to-complete and cash.

• Automate and rebuild our reporting flow – from ERP trial balances to consolidated P&L, balance sheet and cash flow – using AI tools, scripting and data pipelines, replacing manual spreadsheet steps with controlled, repeatable and documented processes.

• Operate and strengthen our internal controls within the framework set by the Finance Manager, including segregation of duties, payment and bank authorisations and documented business procedures, and drive follow-up on auditor recommendations.

• In close collaboration with Settlement, ensure trading-related balances – settlement, imbalance costs, customer prepayments and deposits, and collateral posted to TSOs, DSOs and exchanges – are correctly recognized, invoiced and reconciled

• Support cash and liquidity forecasting and management with the Finance Manager and CFO, including rolling cash forecasts, collateral and trading risk capital tracking, and early warning on cash exposure.

• Prepare and analyse the annual budget and monthly forecast updates for the Finance Manager and CFO, maintaining our driver-based budget model and following up on budget-versus-actual deviations with business owners.

• Handle key accounting areas such as revenue recognition and accruals, capitalisation of development projects, grant periodisation and month-end cost accruals, collaborating with our accountant on more complex accounting topics.

• Support in the year-end close and audit for all group entities, including annual reports, tax specifications and intercompany agreements, in close collaboration with Finance Manager and our external auditors.

• Work closely with our Settlement team and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting – turning data into insight on gross profit by revenue stream, cost of execution and unit economics, and building dashboards that let the business self-serve.

What you bring

Experience and skills (Required)

• 5+ years of experience as a controller, in audit or in a group finance role, ideally in a multi-entity set-up.

• A relevant degree in accounting, finance or economics (e.g. cand.merc., HD-R or cand.merc.aud.).

• Proven hands-on experience running month-end close, consolidation and year-end audit under the Danish Financial Statements Act (Årsregnskabsloven)

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems, preferably e-conomic

• Solid understanding of balance sheet accounting, revenue recognition, capitalised development costs, accruals and intercompany transactions.

• Experience with project controlling – budgets, work in progress, utilisation and project margin follow-up – ideally in a consultancy, engineering, Trading or EPC business.

• A genuine AI-first way of working: you use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot daily and can show concrete examples of finance processes you have automated (e.g. with Python, SQL, Power Query, APIs or low-code tools).

• Strong Excel and financial modelling skills combined with a structured, control-minded approach and high attention to detail.

• The ability to work independently in a fast-paced scale-up, prioritise under pressure and explain financial matters clearly to non-finance colleagues.

• Language: English (required); Danish

Nice to have

• Experience from energy trading, utilities, commodities or financial services – e.g. settlement, collateral, imbalance or margin processes.

• Experience with e-conomic, time registration or PSA tools, ERP migration to a more scalable platform, and BI tools such as Power BI.

• Experience with public grant-funded projects, transfer pricing or building internal controls in a growth company.

• A background from a Big 4 or mid-tier audit firm.

What we offer

• Real responsibility: the chance to improve how close, controls and reporting are run in a scaling energy trading group – not just maintain them.

• An AI-first workplace where you get the tools and the mandate to automate, experiment and rethink how finance is done, working closely with our CFO, trading and tech teams with exposure to board and investor reporting.

• Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.

• A collaborative environment with short decision lines, high trust, and strong cross-functional execution.

• The opportunity to work with forward-looking customers and partners driving electrification and the green transition in Northern Europe.

Ready to apply?

Ready to build an AI-first finance function for a company where every megawatt-hour traded must be settled, reconciled and controlled? If you combine accounting rigour with a builder's mindset, we would love to hear from you.

Deadline

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until 10 December. We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if a suitable candidate is identified and accepted.

About Hybrid Greentech

Hybrid Greentech helps Battery Energy Storage Systems and flexible assets perform across their full lifecycle, from project readiness to real-time multi-market trading. We are a vertically integrated VPP, BRP and retailer. We combine analytics, EPC management, asset integration and automated trading to turn flexibility into reliable value for the grid and for asset owners. We are a diverse, international team of 45+ based in Høje Taastrup, building technology that makes 100% renewable energy workable in practice.

jobs.description:
The overall purpose of Danish Red Cross’ (DRC) international engagement is to increase and strengthen humanitarian impact, inspire and act for human dignity, and enhance resilience and social cohesion in contexts of poverty, conflict and disaster.

The Global Partnership unit leads the coordination and strategic direction of the Danish Red Cross’ international partnerships, external and within the Red Cross and Red Crescent movement. The Unit is responsible for global resource mobilization efforts and initiatives and provides support to countries and regions. The Unit hosts the Danish Red Cross’ core donor specialization knowledge and capacity on compliance and strategies. Furthermore, the unit supports and quality assures proposals to core donors.

The position

As part of the Movement relations and private partnerships team (MOPS), the Partnership Advisor will drive Danish Red Cross’ strategic engagement with Danish and international foundations and private sector actors, with the objective of growing and diversifying non-institutional funding and strategic partnerships. The role combines new partnership development with strategic management and growth of high-value, multi-year partnerships. It focuses on senior-level relationship building, development of innovative partnership models, negotiation of multi-year agreements, and strong partnership stewardship across the full lifecycle. The Advisor will position DRC as a preferred humanitarian partner among Danish businesses, corporate foundations, family foundations, and selected international private sector actors through collaboration within the Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement.

Main responsibilities:

• Develop and implement a multi-year strategy for Danish and international private sector and foundation engagement aligned with DRC’s international priorities.

• Build and convert a qualified pipeline of high-value partnership opportunities, with clear income and partnership-growth ambitions.

• Lead the strategic management of one or more high-value, multi-year foundation partnerships, including relationship management, governance, internal coordination, delivery oversight and identification of opportunities for growth.

• Ensure strong partnership stewardship throughout the grant lifecycle, working closely with programme, finance and operational colleagues to support delivery, reporting, compliance and proactive management of risks and partner expectations.

• Develop partnership models beyond traditional grant funding, including strategic co-creation and multi-stakeholder alliances.

• Support country and regional teams to identify, shape and pursue high-potential private sector and foundation partnerships.

• Work closely with Business Development Advisors, Fundraising, and Operations to align private sector engagement with programming priorities.

• Represent DRC in relevant private sector and foundation networks and relevant Movement platforms related to private sector engagement.

We expect you to have the following qualifications:

• A master’s degree or MBA in Business, International Affairs, International Development or related

• Significant experience (7-10 years) in business development, resource mobilization, partnership development, preferably in the humanitarian or non-profit sector

• Demonstrated success in securing high-value, multi-year private sector or foundation partnerships

• Demonstrated experience managing complex, high-value, multi-year and/or multi-stakeholder partnerships including stakeholder engagement, negotiation, renewal and growth

• Strong established network in Denmark and ideally internationally

• Solid understanding of private sector CSR strategies, corporate foundations, and philanthropic trends

• Strong strategic account-management skills, including experience balancing partner expectations with organisational priorities and operational realities

• Experience coordinating complex partnerships across multiple internal teams, technical areas and geographies

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, Danish is an advantage

As a person you have the following competences:

• High level of strategic thinking and diplomatic and political judgement

• Ability to lead processes and engage people across functions and geographies

• Results-oriented and entrepreneurial mindset and ability to turn opportunities into concrete action.

• Collaborative team player with the ability to build trust and work in a multicultural environment

We offer

A full-time position of 37 working hours per week in an inspiring workplace. You will have the opportunity to work in a diversified motivated team of donor experts and be part of Danish Red Cross’ large global humanitarian action. You will refer to the Head of Global Partnership in Copenhagen.

The position is based in Copenhagen with potential 4-8-week travel. Salary and employment conditions will comply with Danish Red Cross’s collective bargain agreement with AC.

Application and further information

We look forward to receiving your application via the Red Cross home page www.rodekors.dk/job

In case you have questions to the position please contact Head of Global Partnerships, Marie-Chantal Legendre Dahl mcd@rodekors.dk or Team coordinator Vivian Pucher vipuc@rodekors.dk

Application deadline is 20th November 2026; Interviews will take place soon thereafter. The expected date of commencement is as soon as possible, preferably no later than January 1st.

_

Red Cross

Join us. Together we can make a world of difference. The Red Cross is always present. We are the largest humanitarian organisation in the world and for 150 years we have helped alleviate people through wars and disasters, diseases and loneliness. Most countries have signed an agreement which gives the Red Cross Red Crescent Movement a unique position and mandate to provide aid regardless of nationality, race or political views. We currently count 11 million volunteers in 191 countries. We are part of your local community no matter where you live. When disaster strikes, we are there._

Be part of a dynamic and fast-paced International Secretariat - while gaining knowledge of the Danish Red Cross’ international humanitarian work.

Are you interested in international humanitarian work as well as management support and strategic organisational processes? Do you bring experience from an organisation with international engagements? Do you have strong organisational and communication skills? And do you have experience with coordinating meetings and events in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment? Then you might be our new student assistant in the International Secretariat at the Danish Red Cross Headquarters in Copenhagen.

The Danish Red Cross’ International Department supports and cooperates with national societies in countries in Africa, the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. As a student assistant in the International Secretariat, you will be part of a dynamic and fast-paced team in the International Department. The primary function of the International Secretariat is to support the International Director and Management Group in lifting strategic and key cross-cutting areas for the benefit of the International Department as well as the Danish Red Cross as a whole. It provides the best possible support to the International Director and Management Group and ensures a well-functioning governance structure and smooth day-to-day running of the International Department.

As a student assistant in the International Secretariat, you will primarily assist and report to the Senior Executive Secretary and the Management Advisor. At the same time, you will join a team of 11 student assistants in the International Department (3 in the International Secretariat) providing support across 5 units in the International Department, when needed, i.e. Global Partnerships, Operations, Humanitarian Policy & Analysis, Technical Quality & Impact, and Disaster & Crisis Response. This position thus offers you the opportunity to gain extensive experience in various areas of responsibility across the International Department.

Your assignments

The assignments that the student assistant will be responsible for in the International Secretariat are wide-ranging and will for instance include:

• Assisting the International Secretariat with various tasks relating to the planning, implementation, and follow-up on strategic organisational processes in the International Department

• Assisting with internal communication, including maintaining the International Department’s intranet in English, proofreading documents and drafting PowerPoint presentations in English and Danish, and ensuring the layout of various types of documents

• Assisting with the planning and coordination of high-level meetings and large-scale events in the International Department, including the technical set-up (Teams), meeting files, PowerPoint presentations, minutes, practicalities, and follow-up

• Assisting with research and analysis for different target groups

• Assisting with the daily maintenance of the International Department’s office space and contributing to a nice working environment.

Your profile

• You work independently and proactively, but you are also an active team player. You are always ready to chip in and help with any task that is needed – from the mundane to the novel – that working in a dynamic and fast-paced International Secretariat requires.

• You have excellent communication skills in English and Danish (written and verbal), preferably with a proven record of communication to various target groups. You are also familiar with Teams platforms and other digital communication tools – and you are ready to dive into new communication tools if needed.

• You can give concrete examples of your organizational skills and experience, perhaps in relation to meetings/events, and preferably from other student jobs or voluntary work where your contributions made a real difference.

• As you will work in an ever-changing environment that demands high accuracy, you must be well-structured, thorough, reliable, punctual, and flexible.

• With a curious mindset and a drive for new challenges, you also proactively suggest improvements both within and beyond your own responsibilities.

• Preferably, you have knowledge of international development and humanitarian work and possibly also (volunteer) experience from an NGO.

• We expect you to be enrolled at university, doing an academic degree in e.g. social or political science, development studies or similar, preferably having completed your 4th semester and with at least one year of studies remaining.

We offer

You will get the chance to gain first-hand experience of what it is like to work in the International Secretariat that supports the International Director and International Management Group. You will learn about the Danish Red Cross’ international humanitarian work, have highly varied areas of responsibility and receive ongoing supervision and support by your colleagues in the International Secretariat, who value a good and positive team culture while we move at a fast pace.

At the same time, you will get the opportunity to apply what you have learned during your academic program in a challenging, yet meaningful setting. Finally, you will be part of a community of students who collaborate, share knowledge and support one another whenever needed.

The student assistant position in the International Secretariat is vacant from medio January 2027. The weekly hours are 15, and the payment is according to the collective bargaining agreement with HK and AC.

How to apply

Please send your CV and a motivational letter (both in English) by 19 November. Please note that only applications forwarded via the link on the Danish Red Cross web site will be taken into account. The interviews are expected to take place on 24 and 25 November.

If you wish to know more about the position, you are welcome to contact Senior Executive Secretary, Maibritt Damgaard Nielsen at manie@rodekors.dk .
